label: 23. Watching Anis's farewell concert got me thinki…

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Watching Anis's farewell concert got me thinking...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: We're basically the Ark's top three beauties, right?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Obviously.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Right.
Totally.
LOL, the three of you?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: I'm curious what you're laughing about, Commander.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What, you think we're wrong?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean?
Yeah, you guys are the three beauties, for sure...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So I was thinking...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: since we're the beauties of the Ark,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: wouldn't we do pretty well

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: as a girl group?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: It could probably sell,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: but debuting as a pop star

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: isn't exactly easy.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm not being serious or anything.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Just throwing it out there for fun.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: But if we really did do it,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: what should our group name be?
ATB.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Wait,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: don't tell me that stands for "Ark's Three Beauties"?
Yeah, that's right.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: you're banned from naming things.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Seriously, what even is that?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: I think it's fine.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Rapi, you're not naming anything either.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Looks like we've got a name, more or less.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: How do we wanna split the roles?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: We're seriously going with that name?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Absolutely not.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I am not joining a group with a name like that!

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Anis can do the variety shows.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: She's already got her whole persona figured out.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So that leaves dance and vocals, right?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: What about you, Master?
Guess I'll be the producer, then.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: It'd be reassuring if you took on the producer role, Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: We're counting on you.
Leave it to me :3
Time to put my gaming skills to the test.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Being a pop star isn't a game!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Then Rapi and I

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: will hit karaoke

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: and decide who becomes the main vocalist.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: In the meantime, work on your persona, Anis.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: From what I hear, that's what matters on variety shows these days.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: No way,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I'm coming too.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I'll show you exactly who should be the main vocalist.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: It's time you heard what a real pop star is capable of!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Looks like we've got more competition now, but it is what it is.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So, should all three of us go together?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: I'll head out first and wait outside.
